bio.text: Kristen Gonzalez is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 59; she assumed office on January 1, 2023.
She is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for re-election.
Ballotpedia says she lives in Long Island City and has worked as a legislative staffer for the New York City Council, the Obama White House and Senator Chuck Schumer's office.
